The '''Mytaranor sector''', also known as the '''Kashyyyk sector''',<ref name="IC">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref> was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. This sector bordered several other Mid Rim sectors. Planets in the Mytaranor sector included [[Mytaranor]] itself, [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the sector capital, [[Randon/Legends|Randon]]. The sector had many Wookiee colonies, such as [[Kwookrrr]] and [[Rakhuuun]].

This sector, especially the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]], was the site of numerous conflicts, and its two major native species, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], were skilled warriors. The Wookiees were sometimes treated as mere animals, and several times slaver organizations such as [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] or the [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]] set up operations in the sector to exploit them as slave labor. The Trandoshans, on the other hand, often worked with the slavers, or were employed as bounty hunters around the galaxy.

==Description==
[[File:Mytaranor_sector.jpg|thumb|left|225px|The Mytaranor sector and its surrounding [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]]]
The Mytaranor sector was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], in the region known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. This sector bordered the [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian]], [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot]], [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar]], [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax]], and [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sectors]]. The sector featured several trade routes such as the [[Randon Run/Legends|Randon Run]], which connected the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] to Randon; the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|Ootmian Pabol]], linking Randon to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] capital of [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]; and others. The [[Thornhedge Nebula/Legends|Thornhedge Nebula]], which formed from the remains of the [[Kyyr system]] after it went supernova, forms part of the boundary between this sector and the [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Mytaranor sector was the center of the [[Kashyyyk Region/Legends|Kashyyyk Region]], which contained parts of six other sectors, five of which bordered the Mytaranor. The Kashyyyk system, aside from being a trade hub at the intersection of six hyperspace routes, was home to two native species: the Wookiees of Kashyyyk, and the Trandoshans of Trandosha. Kashyyyk was a planet of giant [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] covering all land a kilometer in from the shores. The Wookiees themselves were a hair-covered mammalian species who made their homes on the treetops and on the shores. The Trandoshans were a lizard-like reptilian species. The moons of Alaris were settled by Wookiees in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

The planets of [[Kwookrrr]] and [[Rakhuuun]] were both Wookiee colonies, the former being infamous for its slave factories and farms during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. [[Torn Station]] was a refueling stop near Kashyyyk. [[Mytaranor]], which shares its name with that of the sector, is home to the Mytaranor Slaving Council. The planet of [[Ota]] near the Thornhedge Nebula is an ice planet home to the primitive [[Snogar]].

Randon is the capital of the sector and home to the [[Randoni]], native [[Human/Legends|Humans]] known as skilled bargainers and politicians. Like Kashyyyk, Randon was located at a nexus of trade routes.

==History==
===Early history===
The planet of Kashyyyk was an agricultural planet controlled by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] during pre-Republic years. When the Rakata left, their Force-powered machinery continued working and produced the massive [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] that Kashyyyk became famous for. Wroshyr trees also somehow arrived on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a moon of the gas giant [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]] in the Kashyyyk system. The sector was explored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] somewhere between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> Republic scouts charted the Ootmian Pabol from [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]] through the Mytaranor sector and into Hutt Space around [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].

===Old Republic===
The sector was a minor battleground in the [[Old Sith Wars]]. The [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith]] [[Battle of the Randon system (Great Sith War)|attacked]] Randon as part of their assault on the Slice during the time of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. The [[Randon system/Legends|Randon system]] was again [[Battle of the Randon system (Mandalorian Wars)|attacked]] in [[3962 BBY]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. There was a [[Battle of the Randon system (Jedi Civil War)|battle]] won by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] at Randon. The Mytaranor sector was mostly part of the Sith Empire at its height during this war, though there was a [[Rebellion on Kashyyyk/Legends|rebellion on Kashyyyk]] of Wookiee slaves of Czerka Corporation instigated by former Sith Lord [[Revan/Legends|Revan]].

During the [[Light and Darkness War]] at the close of the [[New Sith Wars]], there were a string of [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Sith]] victories in the Kashyyyk system of the Mytatanor sector. [[Battle of Kashyyyk (New Sith Wars)|At Kashyyyk]] and [[Battle of Hsskhor|at Trandosha]], the [[Gloom Walkers]] led the Sith to victory. [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel]], who would one day become Dark Lord of the Sith, distinguished himself at these battles. There was also a [[skirmish on Alaris Prime]] later.

In the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the Mytaranor sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]], a Wookiee. Shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], a group of Wookiees lead by [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]] received permission to colonize Alaris Prime. This brought them into conflict with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], which had secretly taken the moon to exploit its resources. The Wookiee colonists [[Alaris Prime colonial war|fought off]] the Trade Federation.

During the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and subsequent [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Mytaranor sector was divided between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Loyalists]]. Whereas Kashyyyk and its neighbors were Loyalists, Randon and its neighbors were Separatists during most of the war. During the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] Randon was back in Republic control, but the Confederacy [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|staged an assault]] upon Kashyyyk. [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Clone Army]] during this battle, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] narrowly escaped.

===Galactic Empire===
After the [[Declaration of a New Order]], it came under the authority of the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of [[Sector 3 (Oversector)|Sector 3]], apparently a larger territory with its headquarters on [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]] in [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla sector]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Mytaranor sector was plagued by attacks of the [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]]. The Sector was far away from most of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activities and slaves were "needed" to make the most of the natural resources.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Due to Wookiee loyalty to the Jedi, the planet of Kashyyyk was subject to several [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attacks during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. Kashyyyk was again a battleground in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], it was the site of the [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Nagai invasion)|opening]] of the [[Nagai–Tof War|Nagai invasion]]. Later that year Kashyyyk was [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] from Imperial rule, and it is likely that the rest of the sector was as well.

===After the Empire===
The Mytaranor sector, or Kashyyyk at least, was loyal to the New Republic through all the crises in its time. In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]] it was the site of a [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Imperium Crisis)|battle]] between the Jedi and the [[Second Imperium]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong|invading aliens]] passed through the Mytaranor sector within the first couple of years of war, [[Battle of the Randon system (Yuuzhan Vong War)|taking Randon]]. Kashyyyk, however, was spared from the alien assault, and became a vital New Republic stronghold in the region. After the war, the Mytaranor became part of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], the successor state to the New Republic. Senator [[Triebakk]] of the Mytaranor sector even became part of the [[High Council (Galactic Alliance)|High Council]].

During the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], the Wookiees of the Mytaranor tried to remain neutral while they debated the correct course of action to take. This would not save Kashyyyk from an attack by Galactic Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] and fallen Jedi [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], who led a bombardment on the surface of the forested world. This action provoked a split from the Galactic Alliance by the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]], who form the [[Jedi Coalition]]. Kashyyyk, and possibly other Wookiee worlds, were part of this coalition until the end of the war and the reintegration back into the Galactic Alliance.

By [[137 ABY]], the Mytaranor sector was part of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].

==Senators==
All known Senators of the Mytaranor sector have been Wookiees.
